# Genesyx

> A premium fertility-preparation workspace: cycle awareness, vaginal pH tracking, nutrition guidance, and personalised insights. Educational wellness support — not a medical device.

Genesyx helps people preparing for conception understand their cycle, track daily
signals (mood, energy, symptoms, sleep, hydration, supplements, vaginal pH), and
receive gentle weekly observations. The tracking workspace itself is private and
requires an account; the pages below are the public, readable surface.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Genesyx is, who it's for, and the personalised intake quiz.
- [Approach](/approach): The philosophy behind gently-guided fertility preparation and how the guidance is built.
- [Trust](/trust): How data is stored, secured, and kept private, plus what Genesyx deliberately does not do.
- [Support](/support): How to get help, common questions, and contact details.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): What personal data is collected, how it is used, and your choices.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): The terms covering use of Genesyx.
